titulo: The bag out before it spills
caption:
The bag out before it spills

The trash was full, and it would have held one more day. She took it out anyway, before it spilled.

A bag taken out while it still holds is an easy job, and one that spilled is a long one.

For whoever takes the trash out before it spills.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a full gray trash bag standing on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the bag slides out of the frame to the right. A bubble says taking it out. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, the bag's full but it'll hold, to: took it out. nothing spilled.
